WITH stage_0 AS (
  SELECT "actor.user.name", message, "metadata.log_source", "metadata.uid", time, "user.name" FROM __nano_lake_source__
  WHERE time BETWEEN '2026-09-21 13:15:00.000000' AND '2026-09-21 14:15:00.000000'
  AND (((lower("actor.user.name") = 'jsmith' OR lower("user.name") = 'jsmith')))
),
stage_1 AS (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(time, INTERVAL 2 MINUTE) AS time_bucket, count() AS count
  FROM stage_0
  GROUP BY time_bucket
  ORDER BY time_bucket
)
SELECT * FROM stage_1 LIMIT 100 SETTINGS max_threads=16, max_execution_time=300, optimize_read_in_order=1, optimize_aggregation_in_order=1
